accessibility: Every banner is an alert and is announced when it appears; the skip link is the first element in the tab order and moves focus to the region it names.
The state is carried by words and icon, never by color alone.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Rail, NavItem, Stack, Text, Button, Alert, SegmentedControl, Segment, TabBar and TabBarItem); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog. The shell is the one of the Overview View.

The banners are Alerts in the danger tone, the real ones are square-cornered bars across the full width; the skip link is a card at the top left, the real one is a link that is visually hidden until focused.
The strings of the app are copied under the same Locale keys; the load error cause (workbench.sample.loadError) is sample content.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A signed-in member is on any page of the Workbench; the banners belong to the shell and persist across pages until their cause ends. The page below them is the Overview, drawn as in Overview & readiness.

The base state shows no banner. Variants show one banner at a time; on the page itself two may appear together (the server banner replaces the generic load error, which would repeat the same cause in transport words).

The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; the Workbench chrome follows the Workbench language, so its text is baked here per Locale. The text of a load error is the server's own and is sample content.
spec.intent: Show what the Workbench shell puts between its navbar and its pages when something is wrong, and the skip link that is the first stop of the keyboard: the server cannot be reached, the kit build has failed, a Workspace read failed.
interactionRules: When the server cannot be reached one persistent alert under the navbar says so, tells the person to check that uiux dev is still running and that unsaved edits stay on the page, and offers Retry; while the Workbench retries on its own the alert says it is reconnecting and Retry shows its progress. When the server answers again the alert goes and what was shown is re-read.

While the last kit build has failed a banner says so and says the Preview keeps using the last good build and formal capture waits until a build succeeds; it offers Open Product Kit, except on the Product Kit page itself.
A read that fails for another reason shows the generic error with its cause and Retry.
The skip link is the first tab stop: it stays out of sight until it has focus, then reads Skip to content (the main region of the page) or, on a View page, Skip to canvas.

references.label: Phase 5 of the closed loop: dogfood coverage of the core surfaces
